description: This file defines the `Topic` class within the Opencart CMS Model namespace. The class provides methods for retrieving topic data, topics list, and layout IDs from the database, utilizing caching and database queries. It appears to be part of the model layer in an MVC architecture for managing CMS topics in an Opencart-based project.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Model class for handling CMS topic data, including retrieval of individual topics, list of topics, and layout IDs associated with topics. Uses database queries and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves a specific topic record from the database based on its ID, with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active topics from the database, with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a given topic ID from the database.
